title: The Gambian
author: Dan Brown
description:
Jack Crane, a disillusioned journalist adrift in his own life, receives a cryptic email that pulls him into the heart of one of Africa's most enigmatic  the Richat Structure, or "Eye of the Desert," in Mauritania. What begins as a freelance assignment to document a geological marvel quickly spirals into a haunting odyssey through memory, loss, and the enduring power of names.

Guided-or perhaps haunted-by the enigmatic Augustus Sanyang, a man who seems to exist between worlds, Jack embarks on a perilous journey across the Sahara and into the lush, forgotten waterways of The Gambia.
